'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Ganden Yanaga DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
